_comment: Adversarial TTS mini-set for the client acoustic gate. `say` reads `spoken`; `ref` is the text the user wants pasted; `terms` (ids in `catalog`) is the bias list sent with the clip. kind=target: the sentence says the terms and the list is correct. kind=distractor: the sentence says none of the terms; the list holds only near-homophones of words that are said.
